scope: Frozen Global Evaluation Precedence Step 10 only

input_contract.predicate_requirement: PRED-001..010 assessment_status must all be VALID before Step10; otherwise Step10 is not invoked

asset_credit_class.source: authoritative per-asset static risk profile carried/constructed for Work4 from Authorized Universe product metadata
asset_credit_class.TREASURY: mandate is U.S. Treasury/T-bill/government-only; no corporate-credit mandate
asset_credit_class.MIXED: mandate explicitly spans government and corporate-credit exposures
asset_credit_class.missing_or_unclassifiable: INVALID_INPUT before Step10; do not guess from ticker

effective_duration_years.source: same authoritative duration input used by PRED-003 maturity mapping
effective_duration_years.missing_or_stale: handled before Step10 by frozen data-quality contract

cap_contract.final_if_no_direct: state whose pct=min(base_pct, strictest_cap_pct); exact pct-to-state map 25/50/75/100
cap_contract.continue: adds neither direct state nor cap

current_position_quantity.source: Work3 per-asset existing-position input / canonical broker position

ordered_rules.when: capital_gain_harvest_eligible == true AND PRED-009 == TRIM_WATCH AND PRED-008 == LOW_ATTRACTIVENESS

non_input_note: Root discusses these factors, but frozen PRED-001..010 provides no separate Step10 semantic predicate for them. Work4 must not invent an 11th predicate or ad-hoc threshold in this contract.
